behaviors.name: Ride the waves
behaviors.intent: Float on the simulated sea: sit at the water height under the hull, pitch with the waves along the keel and roll with them across it.

behaviors.name: Patrol
behaviors.intent: Sail slowly across the mouth of the cove, riding the waves.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  let x = -95 + time * 1.4
  let z = 120 - time * 0.35
  self.position = (x, water_height(x, z) * 0.8 - 0.1, z)
  self.rotation = ((water_height(x + 2, z) - water_height(x - 2, z)) * 6, 70, (water_height(x, z + 9) - water_height(x, z - 9)) * 3)
end

behaviors.name: Flicker
behaviors.intent: Flicker like a candle in a sea breeze.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  self.light.intensity = 2.8 + sin(time * 11 + self.id) * 0.25 + random() * 0.5
end
